expiry.label: Package expiry
expiry.hint: What happens to sessions left when a package runs out of time. Kept, the package shows “Expired · ฿3,240 unused” and a manager can extend it or refund that amount. A Thai consumer notice in force from 24 January 2026 treats forfeiting on qualifying courses as unfair; this resort keeps paid, unused value on every package by default.

fullRefund.label: Full refund if unused within
fullRefund.hint: From the day of sale, if nothing has been used. After that, a refund pays the paid share of what is unused.

dueCash.label: Refund due · cash or transfer
dueCash.hint: How soon money must reach the guest. Shown on the return.

dueCard.label: Refund due · card
dueCard.hint: How soon a card refund must reach the guest. Shown on the return.

packageDays.label: Validity · packages
packageDays.hint: How long a new package can be used. Ends 23:59 Bangkok time. Each package can set its own.

voucherDays.label: Validity · vouchers
voucherDays.hint: How long a new voucher can be spent. A voucher sold on its own is forfeited after its last day.

passOn.label: Passing sessions on
passOn.hint: Whether staff can move all unused sessions of a package to someone else. The end date stays the same.

split.label: Package price split
split.hint: How a package's price is shared between its voucher value, sessions and products, for VAT and refunds. Face value fits TFRS for NPAEs. By normal price fits full TFRS: Gold Wellness's voucher share would be ฿442.88.

vat.label: VAT on packages
vat.hint: When VAT is due on a package's sessions and products. Voucher value is taxed when it is spent.

points.label: Points spent
points.hint: As a discount, points lower the VAT base like a coupon. As payment, VAT is on the full price.

pointsExpiry.label: Points expire
pointsExpiry.hint: Months after the customer's last purchase.

payments.title: New payments
payments.intro: Every payment goes through a recorded attempt, so a lost connection never charges twice. Turn it on once, during a short checkout pause.
payments.step1: Tell the desk, then pause checkout. Tills finish what they're doing but can't start a new payment.
payments.step2: Finish or close every open pay panel.
payments.step3: Switch to new payments. This can't be undone.
payments.step4: Each till reloads once and is ready.
payments.pauseHint: Tills can't start a new payment until you resume or switch. Payments already open can be finished.
payments.resumeHint: Tills take payments the current way again.
payments.activateHint: This can't be undone. From now on every payment goes through an attempt, and each till must reload once before it takes payments again.
payments.moreAttempts: More open payments aren't listed. Finish these first.
payments.noTills: No till has opened checkout yet. Open checkout on the desk once to finish.
payments.allReady: Every till has reloaded. You can switch sales on.
